title: I was having issues defining a decent path on my level map... So I asked Gemini to create a short html script where I could draw it myself.
author: Secret_Slide_1357
selftext:
I've done this a few times and it works so well, whether is for drawing nodes paths, choosing particle effects or just looking at a library of potential character movements, it\`s extremely helpful and spares the hit and miss. 

Just ask for a HTML script with the asset location and voilà! So easy...  
Just gotta copy and paste the values top right.

comments.author: Shnatrix
comments.body: Nicely done - just for the laymen here, the path you requested in the nodes, then was drawn using the mud / path right?

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body:
Actually no, I get why some
Would think that… I already had the map image, I knew where I wanted the nodes but getting node paths to follow the same path as the image mid path wasnt really working first. Then came the tool script.
